text: あかく　ひかり　かがやく　とても　うつくしい　ほうせき。

structure.jp: あかく　ひかり　かがやく
とても　うつくしい　ほうせき。

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あかく　ひかり　かがやく　とても　うつくしい　ほうせき
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed in front of a thing describes that thing, like 'that ...' in English. あかく ひかり かがやく ほうせき = 'a gem that shines brilliantly red'.

patterns.name: 〜く (adverb)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last い of a describing word to く makes it tell how an action happens. あかく ひかり = 'shining red'.
